title: 3-Pair MisGAN + GAIN Hints: Extreme 80% MCAR Missingness
intuition: Extreme 80% coordinate missingness in 8D with 10% complete anchor rows and a GAIN partial-hint conditioned neural imputer G_i, testing whether both complete generation (>= 80/100 modes) and neural imputation remain identifiable.
failure_mode: At 80% missingness, identifiability collapses without properly leveraging the 10% complete anchors and hint-conditioned imputer critic.
